body:
## Problem
When a client stops streaming, the last part of the dictation is lost:

- `/ws` only reads binary frames ([fast_server.py:111](https://github.com/dimastatz/whisper-flow/blob/1ebbfd55b91b31aebed266c751cbb8b124560465/whisperflow/fast_server.py#L111)), so the client has no way to say "I'm done, finalize".
- On disconnect, `TranscribeSession.stop()` only sets `should_stop` ([streaming.py:108-111](https://github.com/dimastatz/whisper-flow/blob/1ebbfd55b91b31aebed266c751cbb8b124560465/whisperflow/streaming.py#L108-L111)). The loop exits without transcribing chunks still in the queue, and the last partial is never sent as `is_partial: false`.

For dictation, this means the end of the last sentence goes missing every time.

## Proposal
Accept JSON text frames alongside binary audio on `/ws`:

| Message | Effect |
|---|---|
| `{"type": "start", "model": "...", "language": "en"}` | Optional session options (see also the per-session model issue) |
| `{"type": "flush"}` | Transcribe everything queued and send a final result for the current segment |
| `{"type": "stop"}` | Same as `flush`, then close the socket normally |

On `stop`, `TranscribeSession` should drain the queue, run one last transcription, and send it with `is_partial: false` before closing.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A client that sends audio and then `{"type": "stop"}` receives a final (`is_partial: false`) result that includes the last words spoken.
- [ ] Existing clients that only send binary frames keep working.
- [ ] Tests cover drain-on-stop and `flush`.

## Context
Prerequisite 1 in [docs/vscode.md](https://github.com/dimastatz/whisper-flow/blob/1ebbfd55b91b31aebed266c751cbb8b124560465/docs/vscode.md#4-server-side-prerequisites). Needed by [whisper-code](https://github.com/dimastatz/whisper-code/blob/docs/spec-whisper-flow/docs/specs/0002-whisper-flow-transcription.md) (see "Dependencies on whisper-flow").
title: Finalize on stop: drain queued audio and send a final result
